answer: A bonded staking registry deters Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock slashable capital in escrow before joining market operations. Identities broadcast transaction intents across a peer whisper network, whether trading logistics for shale extraction or refining raw opal. An adversary incurs the verifiable opportunity cost of locked liquidity per spawned identity. However, this barrier penalizes underfunded agents and fails against well-capitalized attackers.
